in_hebrew.name: מיכאל
in_hebrew.meaning: מי הוא אלוהים? או מי דומה לאלוהים?
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיכאל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מי הוא אלוהים?' או 'מי דומה לאלוהים?'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'מי' שפירושו 'מי' ו-'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם מיכאל מוזכר בתנ'ך כמי שפועל כנגד השטן ומגן על ישראל. הוא נחשב לאחד המלאכים החשובים ביותר ביהדות, בנצרות ובאיסלם.

in_greek.name: Μιχαήλ
in_greek.meaning: Τις εἰς Θεός ἢ τίς ὅμοιος Θεῷ;
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Μιχαήλ εἰς τὸ Ἑβραϊκὸν σημαίνει 'Τις εἰς Θεός ἢ τίς ὅμοιος Θεῷ;'. Ὁ ἄγγελος Μιχαήλ εἰς τὴν Καινή Διαθήκη καὶ τὴν Παλαιὰ Διαθήκη ἀναφέρεται ὡς ὁ ἡγέτης τῶν ἀγγέλων καὶ ὁ προστάτης τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἐνίοτε θεωρεῖται ὡς ὁ ἀρχιστράτηγος τῶν ἀγγέλων καὶ ὁ πολέμιος τοῦ Σατανᾶ.

in_latin.name: Michael
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Michael significat 'Quis ut Deus?' vel 'Quis est similis Deo?'. In Scripturis Sacris, Michael archangelus describitur ut princeps angelorum et protector populi Dei. Nomen Michael in traditione christiana saepe associatur cum virtutibus fortitudinis et protectionis.

in_english.name: Michale
in_english.long_meaning: The name Michale is derived from the Hebrew name מיכאל (Mikha'el), meaning 'Who is like God?' or 'Who is similar to God?'. In the Bible, Michael is described as an archangel and the leader of the angels. He is often depicted as a powerful protector and a warrior against evil. The name Michale has been popularized in Christian tradition as a symbol of strength, courage, and devotion to God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Michael has a rich cultural history, being one of the most common names for boys in Eastern Europe, and is traditionally popular in other parts of the world, including the United States. The significant influence of this name can be seen in cultures as diverse as the Jews, Greeks, and Russians, who each have their unique interpretations and connection to the archangel Michael. In Christian folklore, Michael is often depicted as a fierce warrior and protector, and is associated with bravery, strength, and victory.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Michael holds significant spiritual meaning, representing a warrior of God and a defender of the faith. It symbolizes the belief in the power and presence of God, and an eternal reminder of the importance of humility and trust in divine intervention. For many, the name Michael embodies a sense of strength, protection, and courage in the face of adversity. This name can serve as a powerful reminder to call upon the heavenly protector in times of need.
